diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted readings plateau at ~0.95 from 6 h onward, which could indicate either true stationary phase or reader saturation. A dilution series on the 18 h aliquot resolves this: 1:5 dilution reads 0.1975 (back-calculated OD 0.988), 1:10 reads 0.0953 (OD 0.953), and 1:20 reads 0.0474 (OD 0.948). All three independent dilutions back-calculate to the same undiluted OD (~0.95–0.99), matching the direct undiluted reading of 0.9625 within ~3%. If the reader were saturating and true biomass were higher, diluted samples would back-calculate to proportionally higher ODs — they do not. The 10 h aliquot at 1:10 (0.0907 → OD 0.907) also matches its undiluted reading (0.933), confirming proportionality throughout the plateau. The reader responds linearly in this range and the plateau reflects genuine stationary phase; late-culture biomass is at the level the undiluted readings indicate.

message.content: I'll start by checking whether the late-culture readings are saturating the reader. The undiluted readings plateau at ~0.95 from hour 6 onward, which could either be a true stationary phase or reader nonlinearity at high OD. Measuring diluted aliquots will distinguish these.
message.reasoning_content:
Let me think. Readings plateau ~0.95 from hour 6 onwards, but growth from 0.81 (5h) to 0.967 (6h) then flat. Typical plate reader nonlinearity/saturation: OD saturates around 1.0; true biomass may be much higher. To check, measure diluted aliquots at late hours: e.g., 18h at dilution 10. If true OD ~3, diluted reading ~0.3, ×10 = 3 > 0.96.

Budget 6 units. Plan: measure 18h at dilution 10 (2 replicates), 18h dilution 5 maybe, and 6h dilution 10 to compare. Or measure at several late time points at dilution 10: e.g., 10h, 14h, 18h, each 1 replicate, plus replicates. Let's do first: 18h dilution 10 ×2 replicates, and 12h dilution 10 ×1? Better spend: 3 measurements of 18h at dilution 10, and 3 at different times.

Turn 1: measure_od 18h dilution 10, 2 replicates; measure_od 10h dilution 10, 1 replicate. That's 3 units. Then based on results decide.
